message: As a parent, I know that getting kids to think about emergency preparedness can feel like pulling teeth! But it’s so important to have a plan, especially when it comes to being on the road. I recently found a helpful resource that breaks down what to keep in your car for unexpected situations. It’s a great way to start a conversation with the kiddos about safety without making it scary. What’s your favorite tip for keeping your family prepared while on the go? 🚗
